description: 機場四周禁止施放有礙飛航安全物體範圍圖資 [airports] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 民用航空局. 本資料集為提供依據民用航空法第34條劃定公告之機場四周禁止施放有礙飛航安全物體範圍之圖資(KML檔)，前述有礙飛航安全物體，含經人為施放之風箏、天燈、煙火、遙控飛機、氣球或其他可能影響航空器飛航安全之漂浮或移動物體。 空拍機及遙控無人機如在機場周遭施放，亦屬有礙飛航安全物體之一。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 民用航空局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-04-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
